name: ARECIBO Signal
description:
ARECIBO Signal: every crop circle is a message. Digital crop-circle art that encodes real binary messages, a tribute to the 1,679-bit Arecibo message sent on 16 Nov 1974. Decode one or press your own at arecibosignal.com.

This is a meme coin with no utility, no dividends and no promised returns. Not investment advice. Its value can go to zero.
The creator fee paid by pump.fun funds content only (art, website, videos). It is not a dividend, is not shared with holders, and is not principal-protected.
The creator wallet and any creator purchase are disclosed at arecibosignal.com. The story is a tribute and fiction; we do not claim aliens exist. Official links are listed at arecibosignal.com.
